prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1105; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just be called the claimant on this one, if that's all right.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot in Conroe, Texas, at a shopping center. I had just pulled into a spot near the far end, close to the landscaping.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was backing out of the space slowly. I checked my mirror, didn't see anything, and started rolling back. Then I heard a loud bang on the driver's side.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?
A: No. It came from behind a parked van that was blocking the aisle. I never had a clear view of it.
Q: How fast would you say you were moving?
A: Walking pace, maybe less. I was barely moving when it happened.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I put my right arm out to brace myself against the steering wheel and the airbag hit my hand. My wrist was hurting right away, and I was taken to urgent care.
Q: Have you been told what the injury is?
A: The doctor said it's a fracture of the wrist. I have a splint on now and I'm waiting on a follow-up appointment with a specialist.
Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?
A: Briefly. They apologized and said they didn't see me either. We exchanged insurance information and that was about it.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your account?
A: Only that I'm still shaken up and I want my car checked properly, since the driver's door won't open all the way.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
